title: fun club funpack 1 ready to ship!
author: bpatrick
body: I’m a few days late but I’ve finally got the first funpack ready to ship out to the members of the fun club! If you want to get funpack 2 join the club!

comments.text: Question do you ship internationally because I’m from Czech Republic?

comments.author: kevin
comments.text:
@BPatrick.

My father has a good med school story. They were in a class that was dissecting (is that the right term?) a cadaver.

The Dr/Professor asked “Does anyone know why this man is in here?”.

To which he replied “because he’s dead?”.

The professor said “No! It’s because he didn’t listen to his doctor, if he had, he’d still be alive”.

comments.author: bpatrick
comments.text: @kevin: ha! That’s good. Non-compliance of patients seems to be a running theme.
